summary: Pin bar rejected from a confirmed range boundary; target the opposite boundary.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: once i have identified the range, then it becomes very simple to trade it by going long when prices reaches the support level and going short when prices approach the resistance level.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: your stop loss should be below the support level. your profit target is the next resistance level.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: don't never try to trade any setup if it is not strongly rejected from these areas.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: In ranging markets, we trade from the boundaries, i mean from support and resistance levels, don't never try to trade inside the range.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: it is characterized by a very long tail that shows rejection

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: typically all pin bars have a very small real body and a long shadow.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: The Hammer candlestick is created when the open high and close are roughly the same price; it is also characterized by a long lower shadow

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Professional technicians say that the shadow should be twice the length of the real body.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Pin bars with longer tails are more powerful.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: To confirm a ranging market, i have to look for at least two touches of support level, and two touches of resistance level

sources.label: SOURCE_CHART
sources.quote: GOLD Daily: three bullish pin bars at the range support (buy zone)

entry.price: the first executable tick after the signal candle completes (BUY ask / SELL bid)

not_modelled: breakout of the range and its retest (p.105-106): falls under the trend strategies once the market state changes
